CREATIVE ARTS — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #2
====

GRADE: Grade 6
SUBJECT: CREATIVE ARTS
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Best practice when working on Weaving: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Weaving.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Weaving.
   C. Practise Weaving with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Weaving.

2. Best practice when working on Volleyball: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Volleyball.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Volleyball.
   C. Practise Volleyball with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Damage equipment used for Volleyball.

3. Best practice when working on Painting and Collage: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Painting and Collage.
   B. Practise Painting and Collage with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Painting and Collage.
   D. Damage equipment used for Painting and Collage.

4. Best practice when working on Melody: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Melody.
   B. Practise Melody with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Damage equipment used for Melody.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Melody.

5. In music, tempo refers to: (1 mark)
   A. The ticket price
   B. The speed of the music
   C. Only the volume
   D. Only the costume

6. Best practice when working on Descant Recorder: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Descant Recorder.
   B. Practise Descant Recorder with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Descant Recorder.

7. Best practice when working on Athletics: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Athletics with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Damage equipment used for Athletics.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Athletics.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Athletics.

8. Warming up before sport helps to: (1 mark)
   A. Guarantee a trophy
   B. Replace drinking water
   C. Remove the need for rules
   D. Prepare muscles and reduce injury risk

9. Primary colours are: (1 mark)
   A. Brown, pink, and gold
   B. Black, white, and grey
   C. Red, blue, and yellow
   D. Green, orange, and purple

10. Best practice when working on Rhythm and Pattern Making: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Rhythm and Pattern Making.
   B. Practise Rhythm and Pattern Making with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Rhythm and Pattern Making.

11. Best practice when working on Indigenous Kenyan Craft- Pottery: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Indigenous Kenyan Craft- Pottery.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Indigenous Kenyan Craft- Pottery.
   C. Damage equipment used for Indigenous Kenyan Craft- Pottery.
   D. Practise Indigenous Kenyan Craft- Pottery with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

12. Best practice when working on Gymnastics: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Gymnastics.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Gymnastics.
   C. Practise Gymnastics with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Gymnastics.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Analysis of Creative Arts works 15 Total Number of Lessons 180 NOTE: The suggest and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Analysis of Creative Arts works and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain String Musical Instruments and Drawing and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Painting and Collage and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

11. D — Practise Indigenous Kenyan Craft- Pottery with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
